description.narrative: To promote adoption of improved production practices by target farmers, with gradual rollout of farmer-centric agriculturalservicessystems and investment support. Service delivery centered on farmers will promote in practice increased participation ofbeneficiaries both in defining the type of services required and in the delivery itself. The project would also promote improvedratio of overall costs reaching beneficiaries as direct investments. The aim is thus to promote sustainability, effectiveness andefficiency.
